links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT-predicted progression-free survival versus actual PFS from real patient data
links.effect: ChatGPT overestimated PFS; significant discrepancy between predicted and actual (p < 0.05); mean discrepancy 9.19 months; bias 48.57; Cohen's d = 0.189.
links.quote: The AI chatbot tended to overestimate the overall PFS times.

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the performance of ChatGPT in predicting progression-free survival for prostate cancer patients based on clinical variables, without testing any deployment practices or safeguards.
